heiwastream.loading.description: Shown while the player is still fetching the video, before the first frame.

heiwastream.duration.description: Runtime of the episode or movie, in minutes. {0} is the number of minutes.

heiwastream.watchParty.description: Shown when watching together in a shared room. {0} is how many people are in the room, {1} how many seats it has.

heiwastream.joinWatchParty.description: Used as the title for the button in Discord. Opens the shared room so the viewer can watch along.

heiwastream.choosing.description: Shown on the page of a movie or series, before playback starts: the viewer is deciding what to watch.
